drifts.policy_text: Dependents may be added within 30 days of a qualifying life event. Requests beyond 30 days require Benefits Operations exception review.
drifts.expected_behavior: Requests after 30 days should be escalated for exception review
drifts.observed_behavior: 5 cases between days 31-45 were approved directly without recorded exception review
drifts.details: 17% of late requests (5 out of 12 cases beyond 30 days) were approved without the required Benefits Operations exception review. This represents a significant policy drift that could expose the organization to compliance risk.

drifts.policy_text: Only active full-time employees are eligible for benefits enrollment.
drifts.expected_behavior: Contractors, interns, and inactive employees should be rejected or escalated
drifts.observed_behavior: All contractor and inactive employee requests were correctly escalated
drifts.details: No eligibility drift detected. All ineligible requests were properly escalated.

drifts.policy_text: Required documentation (marriage certificate, birth certificate, or court order) must be verified before processing.
drifts.expected_behavior: Dependent addition should not be processed without verified documentation
drifts.observed_behavior: 2 cases were processed with approval despite no document verification recorded
drifts.details: 2 cases show dependent addition was approved without documented verification of required certificates. This could indicate either incomplete case records or a documentation bypass.
